remarks: Two residences. One Long Beach location. Multiple ways to imagine what comes next. Set near some of Long Beach's most recognizable lifestyle destinations, this duplex combines location, existing income, improvement potential, and R-3/LBR3S zoning per the title report. Recreation Park Golf Course and Colorado Lagoon are nearby, with Belmont Shore and Naples just minutes away for dining, shopping, recreation, and the coast. The single-story front residence at 1211 Roswell Avenue is a California bungalow offering two bedrooms, one bathroom, and approximately 918 square feet per assessor.
